questions.stem: The specific latent heat of fusion is the energy required to:

options.text: Raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1 degree C
Change 1 kg of a solid to a liquid at constant temperature
Change 1 kg of a liquid to a gas at constant temperature
Cool 1 kg of a substance by 1 degree C

questions.explanation: Specific latent heat of fusion (Lf) is the energy needed to change 1 kg of a substance from solid to liquid (or vice versa) without any change in temperature. 'Fusion' refers to melting.
